name: Lampad
description: A sad dark nymph living in a cave, waiting for death, who takes the drowned hunter.

timeline.summary: Zoe finds a dark lampad in a cave, who says she is waiting for death.
timeline.quote: the nymph said that she was waiting for death.

citation.text: "Zoe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zoe charms a hunter aiming at a sleeping wolf into drowning in a stream; the lampad takes the body into her cave.
timeline.quote: He fell into the stream and stayed there, drowning.
